question: Arakan and Shan are recognised ethnic groups of ________.
solution:
The correct answer is __**Myanmar**__ [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **Arakan (Rakhine)**:

 
 
• The Arakanese people, also known as **Rakhine**, are an ethnic group primarily residing in the Rakhine State (formerly Arakan) in Myanmar.
 
• The **Rohingya people are a Muslim ethnic minority in Myanmar**, primarily living in the Rakhine State.
 
• The** Rohingyas have faced severe persecution and violence in Myanmar, leading to a humanitarian crisis.**
 
• The conflict has resulted in mass displacement, with many Rohingyas fleeing to neighboring countries, especially Bangladesh.
 
 
 
• **Shan**:
 
 
• The **Shan people are one of the largest ethnic groups in Myanmar, **predominantly residing in the **Shan State** in the eastern part of the country.
 
 
 
• 
 
These ethnic groups have a distinct cultural and historical identity within Myanmar. They are recognized as part of the country's diverse ethnic composition.

 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• Myanmar:

 
 
• Myanmar, also known as Burma, is a country in Southeast Asia.
 
• It is bordered by Bangladesh, India, China, Laos, and Thailand.
 
• The country has a diverse population with over 135 ethnic groups, each with its own language and culture.
 
• The official language of Myanmar is Burmese, and the majority of the population practices Buddhism.
